visualCharacteristics.structure: 4-column grid of centered profile items: circular portrait, name heading, roles line, dark icon-only social button bar

contentPattern: Team/contributor grid: repeating person profiles each with round portrait, name, roles and social icon links. One row per person: cell 1 portrait image, cell 2 h3 name + roles paragraph + plain text social links (text = network label, e.g. Facebook / Twitter / Instagram).
